# Nell Harcourt

## Overview

- **Age:** 13  <sub>[v1 c26 P4](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0004)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c5 P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013), [v1 c10 P30](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0030)</sub>
- **Origin:** Harborough, Nova Scotia  <sub>[v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Teacher  <sub>[v1 c38 P20](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0020)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Nell of Grey Shutters  <sub>[v1 c8 P56](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0056)</sub>; Lucinda  <sub>[v1 c3 P21](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0021)</sub>; Lucinda Harcourt  <sub>[v1 c17 P33](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0033)</sub>; Rosamond Montmorency  <sub>[v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021)</sub>; Seraphine  <sub>[v1 c3 P21](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0021)</sub>

## Appearance

Nell has bright grey eyes, a small pointed chin, a pleasant nose, and freckles. She has long red hair arranged in plaits or a thick coil, which is variously described as ginger, bright, crimson, exceedingly red, auburn, Titian, and briefly green after an attempt to dye it. She possesses a slender, straight-backed frame that stands an inch taller than Isolde Pembroke, along with a alabaster neck.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P1](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0001), [v1 c8 P55](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0055), [v1 c9 P13](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0013), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c10 P30](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0030), [v1 c11 P17](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0017), [v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040), [v1 c13 P1](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0001), [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c15 P32](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0032), [v1 c15 P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c18 P48](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0048), [v1 c27 P16](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0016), [v1 c33 P12](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0012), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 c33 P43](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0043), [v1 c37 P31](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0031), [v1 c37 P32](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0032)_

## Personality

Nell is a highly imaginative, passionate, and unselfish girl with a quick temper and a tendency to hold grudges. She is deeply talkative and prone to drifting into reveries while engaged in routine tasks or daydreaming. Though competitive and easily mortified by academic failure, she is fiercely loyal, generous, and devoted to those she cares about. She takes immense comfort in romanticizing names, places, and everyday life.

## History

After being taken from the Marden orphan asylum by Thirza Abernethy, eleven-year-old Nell Harcourt arrived at Grey Shutters. Though initially grief-stricken and self-conscious about her plain clothes, freckles, and red hair, she quickly won the deep affection of both Thirza and Obed Abernethy. She formed an intense, lasting friendship with Isolde Pembroke, establishing a playhouse called Larkrise and frequenting the nearby woods and waterways. Nell attended Brierley school under Mr. Pidgeon and later Miss Thorne, engaging in a fierce academic rivalry with Hugh Carrow while establishing warm friendships with classmates such as Odette Pullen, Opal Pettigrew, and Tillie Gammon. She saved Posy Fay Pembroke's life during a croup attack, resolving a misunderstanding over accidental intoxication with Mrs. Pembroke. After completing her studies at Brierley, Nell passed the entrance exams for Regent's Academy in town, taking on the demanding Second Year course alongside Hugh Carrow and winning the prestigious Avery scholarship essay competition. Following Obed's sudden death from a stroke, Nell chose to forgo her scholarship to stay at Grey Shutters, accepting a local teaching post in Delford to support and care for Thirza.

## Background by volume

- Born in Harborough, Nova Scotia to high school teachers Edmund and Bertha Harcourt  <sub>[v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011)</sub>
- Orphaned at three months old when both parents died of fever  <sub>[v1 c5 P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013)</sub>
- Raised by Mrs. Thomas in Harborough and Marysville until age eight while helping care for her children  <sub>[v1 c5 P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013), [v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014)</sub>
- Lived upriver with Mrs. Rudge for over two years assisting with her eight children  <sub>[v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v1 c5 P15](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0015)</sub>
- Spent four months in the orphan asylum at Marden before being taken in by Thirza Abernethy  <sub>[v1 c5 P15](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0015)</sub>
- Attempted to dye her hair green in her early youth  <sub>[v1 c27 P16](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0016), [v1 c37 P31](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0031)</sub>

## Quotes

> Oh, I’m not ashamed of it, only Lucinda is better to my liking. I’ve always pictured my name being Lucinda—at least, I always have in recent years.  <sub>[v1 c3 P21](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0021)</sub>

> Gracious heavenly Father, I thank Thee for the Petal Road of Delight and the Lake of Glassy Waters and Bonny and the Frost Maiden.  <sub>[v1 c7 P21](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0021)</sub>

> You are merely Nell of Grey Shutters, and my mind pictures you, precisely as you appear at this moment, every time I endeavor to pretend that I am the Lady Lucinda.  <sub>[v1 c8 P56](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0056)</sub>

> Being pretty is what I would choose over being clever. Also, Wilfred Mott is someone I detest, as I cannot tolerate a boy whose eyes goggle.  <sub>[v1 c15 P23](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0023)</sub>

> I bear no resentment toward you, Mrs. Pembroke. I guarantee you once and for all that my intention was not to make Isolde drunk and from now on I will drape the blanket of forgetfulness over what happened.  <sub>[v1 c18 P48](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0048)</sub>
